name: codex-orchestrator
description: Dual-Brain orchestration plugin for Google Antigravity (v3.8) with declarative verbosity, structured review receipts, facts-only implementation previews, and objective-first verification. Includes verified patch custody, opt-in cross-model TDD, and native session handoff.
suggestedPrompts: /impl Write a Spec, delegate scoped implementation to Codex CLI (optional --tdd / Proof-of-Work), verify independently, and brief me
/dag Lock a shared contract, run parallel managed-worktree Codex workers with ownership table & patch custody, and brief me
/research Freeze a source corpus, run parallel Codex research + blind critique (or /run-workflow template), spot-check citations, and brief me
